claims.quote: Betta krataios is a paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish that appears endemic to the lower River Kapuas basin in West Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo.
It appears endemic to parts of the lower River Kapuas basin within the province of western Kalimantan (Kalimantan Barat), Borneo, Indonesia.
